type_descriptions.ANL: You love solving problems, working with data, and thinking deeply before acting. You ask 'why' and 'how' more than most people.
type_descriptions.LDR: You are a natural at guiding people, making decisions under pressure, and taking responsibility when it counts.
type_descriptions.CRE: You think outside the box, express yourself boldly, and see possibilities where others see walls.
type_descriptions.HLP: You are driven by purpose. You care deeply about people and feel most alive when you are making a real difference in someone's life.
type_descriptions.TEC: You enjoy building, fixing and understanding exactly how systems and technology work. You want to make things that function.
type_descriptions.ENT: You are ambitious, spot opportunities others miss, and feel the pull to build something of your own from nothing.

questions.question: What fires you up most about your future?

options.text: Solving complex problems and understanding exactly how things work
Building technology, apps, or systems that actually do something
Starting a business and being my own boss one day
Leading a team and making decisions that matter

questions.question: In a group project, people naturally see you as...

options.text: The researcher — you dig deep and bring the facts
The creative one — your ideas and designs stand out
The leader — you naturally take charge and organise
The supporter — you look after everyone and keep morale high

questions.question: Which of these job descriptions sounds most like YOU?

options.text: Software developer, IT engineer, cybersecurity or data scientist
Doctor, nurse, teacher, social worker or counsellor
Graphic designer, filmmaker, musician or architect
CEO, startup founder, investor or business consultant

questions.question: When you face a really hard problem, what do you do?

options.text: Break it into pieces, research thoroughly, and think it through logically
Try something creative and unusual that others haven't thought of
Bring people together and lead everyone toward a solution
Think about who is affected most and how to help them first
A quiet space with data, books, research and deep thinking
A tech lab with screens, code, machines and smart systems
A buzzing office where I run projects and drive results
A creative studio full of design, colour and expression

questions.question: In 10 years, which outcome would make you the proudest?

options.text: I made a scientific discovery or solved a problem that baffled experts
I built technology that millions of people use every day
I am leading a respected organisation that is changing South Africa
I have directly helped hundreds of people live better lives

questions.question: Your closest friends would describe you as...

options.text: Deeply logical — always asking why and how, never accepting surface answers
Ambitious and driven — you always push for more and hate losing
Warm and caring — someone always comes to you when they are struggling
Bold and creative — you do things differently and love expressing yourself

questions.question: Which of these would make your family the proudest?

options.text: You engineer or invent something the whole country benefits from
You build a successful company that employs people in your community
You become a respected leader — principal, director or government official
You heal, teach or transform lives as a doctor, nurse or social worker
